hook: She spent the night at the bottom of a cliff.
narration: She spent the whole night stranded at the bottom of a cliff on Lake Michigan, [short pause] with her dog.
Coast Guard crews from Air Facility Muskegon and Station Ludington came for them.
To hoist her safely, rescuers first helped her out into the water, where the helicopter could pick her up.
Another Coast Guard helicopter filmed the whole thing from above.
outcome: The crews rescued the woman and her dog from the bottom of the cliff.
title: Stranded overnight under a cliff
description:
A woman and her dog were stranded overnight at the bottom of a cliff near Ludington, Michigan. On July 19, 2019, Coast Guard crews from Air Facility Muskegon and Station Ludington rescued them, helping her into the water so she could be hoisted safely.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, recorded by Air Station Traverse City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/698025
